title: Residential rental application fee cap ($50)
requirement: A landlord or agent may not require an application or similar fee exceeding $50 to apply to lease or sublease a residential rental property for dwelling purposes; the limit is adjusted annually for inflation.
coverage_conditions: Residential rental property offered for dwelling purposes; does not apply to units in one-family or two-family dwellings offered for rent or to a real estate licensee unless the licensee is the landlord.

applicability.per_tenancy: Exemption for a licensee of the New Jersey Real Estate Commission unless the licensee is the landlord of the property.
coverage_quotes: a dwelling unit located in a one-family or two-family dwelling that is offered for rent
a licensee of the New Jersey Real Estate Commission, unless the licensee is the landlord of the residential rental property

exemptions: Units in one-family or two-family dwellings offered for rent; a licensee of the New Jersey Real Estate Commission, unless the licensee is the landlord.
penalty: Up to $500 for a first offense, up to $750 for a second offense, and up to $1,000 for each subsequent offense; the amount wrongfully charged is remitted to the applicant.
quoted_span: A landlord, or agent thereof, shall not require an application or other similar fee to apply to lease or sublease a residential rental property for dwelling purposes, which exceeds $50.
